messages.subject: Completed: Analyze content marketing strategy options
messages.body:
Task "Analyze content marketing strategy options" has been completed.

Recommendation: Start with weekly blog posts + Twitter thread repurposing. Newsletter when audience exceeds 500 subscribers.

Key findings:
- Blog posts have the best long-term SEO value
- Twitter threads can be repurposed from blog content with minimal effort
- Newsletter requires a critical mass of subscribers to justify the effort

messages.subject: Progress update: API pricing research
messages.body:
Halfway through the competitor API pricing analysis. Found 7 competitors with public pricing.

Early observation: most offer a free tier with 1000 requests/month. Paid tiers range from $29-$99/month.

Will have the full comparison ready by tomorrow.
